C0468.title: Beijing Fraud Case: Victim Transfers Nearly One Million Yuan, Gets a 'Surprise' 24 Hours Later
C0468.summary: In December 2024, an accountant surnamed Xiao at a company in Beijing's Tongzhou district was deceived into transferring 985,000 yuan by a suspect impersonating company leadership. The fraudster created a group chat posing as the executive to induce the transfer. Tongzhou police successfully froze the payment within 24 hours and returned the full amount of the defrauded funds.

references.title: Beijing bizarre case: Transfer nearly a million yuan to scammers, gets a 'surprise' 24 hours later
